items.title: 3 Healthcare REITs Raised Their 2026 Outlooks as Senior Housing Demand Grows
items.summary: Baby boomers are turning 80, and three healthcare REITs just raised their 2026 guidance to capture the demand. Yet each dividend carries a cut in its past and a different risk, so which payout can retirees actually trust?

items.title: Ardent Health stock tumbles on 7M share secondary offering
items.summary: Investing.com -- Ardent Health Inc (NYSE:ARDT) shares fell 13.9% in after-hours trading Tuesday after the company announced a secondary public offering of 7 million shares by existing stockholders.

items.title: Welltower and Ventas Are Riding the Same Senior Housing Boom, but Their Valuations Tell Different Stories
items.summary: Two senior housing REITs ride the same wave of Baby Boomers turning 80, yet one stock costs far more per dollar of cash flow. Which landlord actually fits a retiree living off dividends, and which one rewards patience?

items.title: Ventas: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Tight construction conditions shield Ventas from new competition while demographic tailwinds drive multiyear demand growth.

items.title: $200,000 in These 2 Senior Housing REITs Could Pay You $3,600 a Year
items.summary: Baby boomers are turning 80, and two landlords stand ready to house them. One has a sharper growth story, the other pays the bigger check, and both carry a dividend scar from 2020 that retirees should weigh before buying.

items.title: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish on Ventas Stock?
items.summary: Ventas has outperformed the broader market over the past year, and analysts are highly optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: How Investors May Respond To Ventas Stock After Higher Earnings Guidance
items.summary: Ventas reported third quarter 2026 revenue of US$1,831.79 million and net income of US$65.38 million, while raising full year net income guidance to US$324 million to US$339 million, or US$0.64 to US$0.67 per share. The guidance increase is tied mainly to accretive senior housing investment activity. items.title: America Is Running Out of Senior Housing. These 3 REITs Could Cash In
items.summary: Nearly 70 million boomers are turning 80 while new senior housing construction crawls near record lows. Three healthcare REITs sit in the middle of that squeeze, but only one pays a big yield, and it leaves the thinnest margin for error.
